#compdef tachy
#
# tachy zsh completion
#
# Install for the current user (needs compinit, which most frameworks
# set up already):
#   mkdir -p ~/.zfunc
#   tachy generate completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_tachy
#   fpath=(~/.zfunc $fpath)   # before compinit in ~/.zshrc
#
# Regenerated by hand from the CLI surface — tests/generate.d fails
# `dub test` when a command word or option is missing from here.

_tachy() {
  local -a global_opts

  # selection candidates: all, host names, @tags — from the inventory
  # (no host is contacted), honoring -i on this command line
  local -a inv_args
  local i
  for (( i = 2; i < CURRENT; i++ )); do
    case "${words[i]}" in
      -i|--inventory)
        inv_args=( "${words[i]}" "${words[$((i+1))]}" )
        break
        ;;
    esac
  done
  local cands
  cands=$(tachy hosts list --completion "${inv_args[@]}" 2>/dev/null)
  local -a cands_arr
  cands_arr=( ${(f)cands} )
  local -a names
  names=( ${cands_arr:#@*} )
  names=( ${names:#all} )

  # comma-separated selection: match and re-insert the earlier elements
  _tachy_selection() {
    if [[ $PREFIX == *,* ]]; then
      IPREFIX=${PREFIX%,*},
      PREFIX=${PREFIX##*,}
    fi
    compadd -- $cands_arr
  }

  global_opts=(
    '(-i --inventory)'{-i,--inventory}'=[inventory file (default: inventory.pravic)]:inventory:_files'
    '(-v --verbose)'{-v,--verbose}'[show executed commands, change details and command output]'
    '--color[force colored statuses even when stdout is not a tty]'
    '--direct[apply tasks files directly in this process]'
    '--direct-report=[with --direct: write "ok changed failed" counters to PATH]:report:_files'
    '--events[print one JSON event per line on stdout (machine mode)]'
    '--keep-bundle[keep each host temporary bundle after the run]'
    '--config=[optional config file]:config:_files'
    '--identity=[age identity for { age = ... } inventory vars]:identity:_files'
    '--address=[webui/webdoc bind address (default 127.0.0.1)]:address:'
    '--port=[webui/webdoc port]:port:'
    '--completion[hosts list: print selection candidates for completions]'
    '(-y --yes)'{-y,--yes}'[upgrade: skip the y/N confirmation]'
    '(-h --help)'{-h,--help}'[show help]'
  )

  local context state line curcontext="$curcontext"
  _arguments -C $global_opts \
    '1:command:->cmd' \
    '*::argument:->args'

  case $state in
    cmd)
      local -a commands
      commands=(
        'apply:apply the tasks files to the selected hosts'
        'a:short form of apply'
        'check:check mode: report would-be changes without applying'
        'c:short form of check'
        'hosts:inspect hosts: list, info'
        'generate:write scaffolding: keys, samples, completions'
        'g:short form of generate'
        'webui:start a local web console'
        'webdoc:serve the built-in documentation as a web site'
        'man:print the full manual'
        'version:print the version (the build date)'
        'v:short form of version'
        'upgrade:upgrade tachy to the latest GitHub release'
        'help:show help'
      )
      _describe -t commands 'tachy command' commands
      ;;
    args)
      case $line[1] in
        apply|check|a|c)
          if (( $#line == 1 )); then
            _tachy_selection
          else
            _files   # later positionals are tasks files
          fi
          ;;
        hosts)
          if (( $#line == 1 )); then
            compadd -- list info
          else
            case $line[2] in
              info) compadd -- $names ;;
              list) (( $#line == 2 )) && _tachy_selection ;;
            esac
          fi
          ;;
        generate)
          if (( $#line == 1 )); then
            compadd -- key task config project completions
          else
            case $line[2] in
              completions) compadd -- bash zsh fish ;;
              *) _files ;;
            esac
          fi
          ;;
        help)
          compadd -- apply check hosts generate webui webdoc man version upgrade help
          ;;
      esac
      ;;
  esac
}
_tachy "$@"
